prompt: Compare net expected settlement against the forecast.

results.text: Net expected settlement is USD -6.1 million against a forecast of USD 19.3 million, a USD 25.4 million unfavourable variance driven by the delayed EMEA settlement.

sql.command: SELECT SUM(forecast_net_flow_usd) AS forecast, SUM(actual_net_flow_usd) AS actual FROM aa_liquidity_variance
